core_obligations: Choose an injective resolution F to I^bullet in Ab(C) and build the double complex C^bullet(U, I^bullet) together with the horizontal map from Gamma(U, I^bullet) to the left column and the vertical map induced by F to I^0 into the bottom row (etale-cohomology.tex lines 1788-1803).

Establish row exactness in positive degrees: injectives of Ab(C) stay injective in PAb(C) through the exact left adjoint sheafification, and Cech cohomology of an injective presheaf vanishes in positive degrees; then identify the kernel of the first Cech differential with Gamma(U, I^bullet) using that I^bullet is a complex of sheaves, so that the cohomology of the total complex is the cohomology of global sections (lines 1804-1815).

Compute the E_1-page columnwise: the q-th cohomology of the p-th column is the product over the multi-indices of H^q(U_{i_0} times_U ... times_U U_{i_p}, F), which is the value of the presheaf H^q(F) on that intersection, giving E_2^{p,q} = H^p(U, H^q(F)) abutting to H^{p+q}(U, F) (lines 1817-1829).

proof_roadmap.step: Build the double complex from an injective resolution and locate the two comparison maps (lines 1788-1803).

proof_roadmap.step: Prove row exactness in positive degrees and identify the total-complex cohomology with H^0(U, F) (lines 1804-1815).
Read the E_1-page columnwise as products of cohomology of the Cech intersections, giving the stated E_2-page (lines 1817-1829).

difficulty_reason: The theorem produces the spectral sequence E_2^{p,q} = H^p(U, H^q(F)) converging to H^{p+q}(U, F) for an arbitrary covering U = {U_i to U} of an object of a site and an arbitrary abelian sheaf F, with H^q(F) the presheaf V mapping to H^q(V, F). The proof at etale-cohomology.tex lines 1788-1803 must first place the global-sections complex and the Cech complex of an injective resolution into one double complex, and then argue row exactness in positive degrees by combining two separate facts: injectives of abelian sheaves remain injective as presheaves (Tag 03OV, via the exact left adjoint sheafification) and Cech cohomology of an injective presheaf vanishes above degree zero (Tag 03OR). The step that pins the abutment is the identification at lines 1809-1815 of the kernel of the first Cech differential with Gamma(U, I^bullet), which uses that the resolution consists of sheaves rather than merely presheaves; the E_2-page is then read off columnwise at lines 1817-1829.

compared.difference: Public 275 (lemma-cohomological-descent-finite) builds the augmented cosimplicial complex of the Cech nerve of a surjective finite morphism of schemes and uses finite-pushforward acyclicity; the present task proves the general Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence of any covering on any site, whose proof instead goes through injective resolutions and a double complex. Neither statement implies the other as stated.

Public 2869 replaces ordered Cech intersections by unordered configurations of distinct points on algebraic spaces with sign local coefficients; the present task is the unordered-free, coefficient-free spectral sequence of an arbitrary covering on a site.
Public 291 counts fppf hyperdescent for unbounded quasi-coherent complexes, a different statement and a different technique.
